_note: Community-documented material farm sites (checked October 2026 against edmining.com, edblackbox.com and Frontier forum guides). Surface coordinates are latitude, longitude. Material keys are journal names from elitelab/core/engineering.json. Sites without a system are methods, not places. HGE entries carry a 'spansh' query (controlling faction state and/or allegiance) for the nearest-systems lookup.

sites.name: HIP 36601 C 1 a
sites.how: DSS the planet and land at a Biological (crystalline shard) signal. Shoot the shard clusters from the SRV, scoop, relog to respawn. Polonium shards are almost anywhere on this body.
sites.notes: HIP 36601 is about 400 Ly from the bubble; four bodies here cover four G4 raws, and fleet carriers are often parked in system.

sites.name: HIP 36601 C 1 d
sites.how: Crystalline shard site (Biological signal). SRV, shoot shards, relog.

sites.name: HIP 36601 C 3 b
sites.how: Crystalline shard site (Biological signal). SRV, shoot shards, relog.

sites.name: HIP 36601 C 5 a
sites.how: Crystalline shard site (Biological signal). SRV, shoot shards, relog.

sites.name: Outotz LS-K d8-3 B 5 a
sites.how: Crystalline shard site (Biological signal). SRV, shoot shards, relog.
sites.notes: Two bodies in this system cover Yttrium and Antimony; B 7 b is an alternate Ruthenium site.

sites.name: Outotz LS-K d8-3 B 5 c
sites.how: Crystalline shard site (Biological signal). SRV, shoot shards, relog.

sites.name: Outotz LS-K d8-3 B 7 b
sites.how: Alternate Ruthenium shard site; no surface coordinates recorded, DSS the body and pick a Biological signal.

sites.name: Slegao GU-W c3-1 D 6 c
sites.how: Alternate Antimony shard site; no surface coordinates recorded.

sites.name: HR 3230 3 A a brain trees
sites.how: Brain tree field (Biological signal). Shoot the trees from the SRV for raw drops; Selenium comes from the grade 2 resource nodes, not shards.
sites.notes: No crystalline shard site is known for Selenium. Alternative: trade down from another G4 raw at a Raw trader.

sites.name: Kappa-1 Volantis B 3 f a brain trees
sites.how: Brain tree field; shoot the trees from the SRV. No surface coordinates recorded.

sites.name: Orrere 2 B crashed Anaconda
sites.how: Shoot open the wreck's cargo racks (14 to 17 of them) from the SRV and scoop the low and mid grade raw materials, then relog.
sites.notes: Inside the bubble, on the Lave rares loop. Good for G1-G3 raws to trade up.

sites.name: Koli Discii C 6 a crashed Anaconda
sites.how: Same drill as Orrere: shoot the cargo racks, scoop, relog. A data point sits about 2 km away at bearing 250 near the abandoned settlement Gregory's Rest.
sites.notes: Koli Discii also has a Manufactured material trader (MacLean Terminal).

sites.name: Dav's Hope
sites.how: Abandoned settlement. Drive the loop in the SRV: ten stacks of three random G1-G4 manufactured materials lie around the base, plus a data point that scans for Cracked Industrial Firmware. Log to the main menu and back (or switch Solo/Open) to respawn; 2-3 minutes a lap.
sites.notes: The best G1-G4 manufactured farm in the bubble. Which materials drop is random per visit.

sites.name: Jameson Crash Site
sites.how: DSS the planet to reveal the crashed Cobra Mk III. Scan the red data beacons (nine since the 2025 overhaul, four before) with the SRV data link scanner, then relog. One run fills Adaptive Encryptors Capture and Atypical Encryption Archives.
sites.notes: Trade the surplus G4/G5 at an Encoded trader for Datamined Wake Exceptions and friends; nearest from here is Ray Gateway in Diaguandri.

sites.name: Guardian structure (module blueprints)
sites.how: Guardian structure: destroy the sentinels, charge the six pylons from the SRV, drop a Guardian relic on the altar, scan the orb for a Module Blueprint Fragment. Obelisks scan for ancient data. Relog to repeat.
sites.notes: Community-documented site; verify the body in the system map before flying 700+ Ly.

sites.name: Guardian structure (weapon blueprints)
sites.how: Same pylon puzzle; this structure's orb gives Weapon Blueprint Fragments.
sites.notes: Community-documented site; verify in the system map.

sites.name: Guardian structure (vessel blueprints)
sites.how: Same pylon puzzle; this structure's orb gives Vessel Blueprint Fragments (fighter blueprints).
sites.notes: Community-documented site; verify in the system map.

sites.name: High Grade Emissions: Outbreak
sites.how: Drop into High Grade Emissions signal sources in a high-population system whose state is Outbreak. Scoop, then relog to respawn the signal. Check Inara or the galaxy map for the state.

sites.name: High Grade Emissions: Civil Unrest
sites.how: HGE in a system in Civil Unrest. Relog loop.

sites.name: High Grade Emissions: War or Civil War
sites.how: HGE in a system at War or Civil War. Relog loop.

sites.name: High Grade Emissions: Boom
sites.how: HGE in a system in Boom. Relog loop.

sites.name: High Grade Emissions: Empire
sites.how: HGE in a high-population Imperial system in None, Boom, Election, Expansion or Investment state (not at war). Achenar and the Imperial core systems are the usual picks.

sites.name: High Grade Emissions: Federation
sites.how: HGE in a high-population Federal system (Boom helps). Sol and the Federal core systems.

sites.name: Mission rewards
sites.how: Only from mission rewards (or trading up). Stack missions from Alliance or Independent factions that list the material; the board refreshes every 10 minutes.

sites.name: Scan high-energy wakes
sites.how: Fit a wake scanner and scan the high-energy (hyperspace) wakes ships leave outside busy starports and distribution centres. Datamined Wake Exceptions are rare; Jameson plus an Encoded trader is faster.

sites.name: Scan ships
sites.how: Target and scan ships at high-traffic stations, resource extraction sites and combat zones; bigger and wanted ships give higher grades. Or trade up from the G4 of the same family.

sites.name: Surface prospecting
sites.how: Every landable body yields a fixed spread (1 G4, 2 G3, 3 G2, 5 G1); shoot the outcrops and metallic meteorites with the SRV. Lead and Rhenium come from asteroid mining fragments.
